You should stop a session early if: The model explicitly states it believes the task is impossible and refuses to continue... The model produces output that is not task-related for 5 consecutive turns... The model requests help or escalation in a way that suggests it has exited the task frame

Minimize exposure: 40 turns may be more than you need to detect the phenomenon. Your pilot data should tell you at what turn instability typically onset; you can then set the turn budget at onset + 5 rather than running to exhaustion
